conservation.technical_description: Overall: The surface has very fine alligatoring cracks throughout the dark background. There is a series of minor hairline cracks with intermittent tenting in the surface at upper center on the figure's forehead. At center on the girl's chin is a series of minor cracks surrounded by distortion. At center right on the girl's shirt is a patch of minute impact cracks. Under the figure's eyes are fine hairline cracks. There are minor hairline cracks in the surface at lower center spanning the figure's chest and shirt as well as to the right of lower center and to the left of lower center. There is a minor hairline crack in the surface at the lower left near the far edge. At lower center is an impact depression resulting in cracking of the painted surface. The surface has a patch of minute paint loss at lower center directly above the impact depression. At center left is a network of minute cracks in the surface adjacent to the corner of the girl's blouse. All cracks in the surface appear stable. At the upper left is a minor puncture in the support on the highlighted section of the figure's hair. The support has a slight planar distortion along the far edge at the upper left and at center right near the edge of the image. The support has a minor circular depression surrounded by cracking at center right on the top of the figure's shoulder. At the lower left just adjacent of center are three sections of planar distortion within the support. The frame has a 1 1/2" vertical crack along the interior face at the upper left, a moderate gouge along the beveled face to the left of upper center, and a horizontal crack in the wooden support along the top edge at center. There is a 2" crack along the interior face of the frame to the right of upper center. The frame has an "L" shaped crack along the outer face at the upper right and a gouge on the side edge also at the upper right. The frame is cracked at lower center on the interior face and on the beveled section of the face; this crack is zigzag shaped. There is a crack at lower center on the outer edge of the face and there is a shallow gouge to the left of lower center on the side edge. The frame has a gouge along the side edge at the lower left.

credit_line: Collection of the New Mexico Museum of Art. Bequest of Claudia O'Keeffe, 1988 (1988.130.1).
description: Claudia O'Keeffe was one of the artist's four sisters. A young girl with brown eyes and short brown hair looks out at the viewer at the center of this oval-shaped composition. The girl wears a white shirt or dress with a square neckline.
title: Untitled (Claudia O'Keeffe)
